bead.title: workbench: add ADR-016 compatibility banner to SD-015
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo currency check (cf. AR-2026-05-15-benchmark-model-browser). ADR-016 (cells-as-self-describing-evidence, 2026-05-16) landed after SD-015 was written. SD-015 needs a top-of-document banner stating: cells now embed resolved profile snapshots, profile-YAML joins and PROFILE_ALIASES are retired, existing Parquet artifacts remain backward-compatible.

Source review: fizeau-a880e449.
bead.acceptance: SD-015 carries an ADR-016 compatibility banner with the three bullets above plus a pointer to ADR-016.
